children: THOR INDUSTRIES INC reported fiscal 2026 revenue of $9.608B and diluted EPS of $3.38, with net income attributable to the company of $177.539M; revenue was essentially flat year‑over‑year while earnings declined notably amid margin pressure.
Revenue was $9.608B, compared with $9.579B in the prior year; YoY change 0.3%.
Net income was $177.539M, compared with $258.559M in the prior year; YoY change (31.3%).
Diluted EPS was $3.38, compared with $4.84 in the prior year; YoY change (30.2%).
Consolidated net sales were essentially flat (+0.3%); North America declined while Europe grew, driven by motorcaravans and motorized products.
Demand shifted by channel and product: wholesale and retail softened in North America, towable unit shipments fell while motorized shipments increased.
THOR maintained market share leadership (North America roughly 37–50% by product; Europe ~27% in motorcaravans) supported by a broad dealer network.

Management executed broad restructuring to improve labor efficiency and reduced SG&A, but margins were pressured by a mix shift to lower‑margin towables and higher material costs, plus tariff and chassis pressures; some offset came from other income.
The company absorbed some cost increases to help keep products affordable, weighing on profitability during the year.
